title: noroot left open (nfs) — review required
description: noroot runs with an open setting: /data *(rw,no_root_squash). Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply root_squash plus host ACLs and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
